Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production portrait mobile slot-game cabinet backdrop for Cocos Creator, behind live reels and controls
Primary request: an original full-height GEM CLASSIC real casino slot machine with a compact vintage three-reel identity and a cabinet shape unlike the other machines
Scene/backdrop: one front-facing freestanding classic mechanical-style cabinet in a softly blurred cheerful casino; curved chrome and rose-gold shoulder lights, burgundy enamel body, cream center panels, large ruby and emerald jewel lamps, pearl pin lights, subtle side lever housing integrated into the silhouette
Subject/layout: blank arched burgundy marquee at the top; small blank ivory balance display below; one large empty pale cream 3-reel aperture in the upper-middle, visually emphasizing three broad columns; narrow blank win plaque; compact physical button shelf with separate left minus and plus wells, oversized central spin recess and small right auto recess; shorter rounded lower body with a faceted ruby-pearl medallion
Style/medium: high-end photorealistic 3D premium vintage casino cabinet, believable chrome, enamel, molded glass and incandescent bulbs, polished mobile-game production asset
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, exact front orthographic view, compact wider-shouldered silhouette filling 94 percent height and 92 percent width, all live UI zones centered and unobstructed
Lighting/mood: soft rose marquee glow, warm cream highlights, crisp gem sparkle, lively nostalgic gambling-floor energy without harsh neon
Color palette: warm burgundy, cream enamel, rose gold, polished pale chrome, ruby red, emerald green, pearl white
Constraints: visibly a three-reel classic cabinet and structurally different from the pearl and coin machines; empty reel aperture; blank marquee and plaques; no reel symbols; no characters; no text; no letters; no numbers; no logos; no watermark; no currency symbols; original design only
Avoid: fruit or candy art, neon cyberpunk, black-dominant machine, dark bar, cheap plastic, flat vector art, clutter over live UI zones
